newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Xinjiang Industrial to issue 30 mln A shares.
newsitem.headline: Xinjiang Industrial to issue 30 mln A shares.

text.p: Xinjiang Light Industrial Co Ltd has filed an application with the China Securities Regulatory Commission for an offer of 30 million A shares, an official involved in the issue said on Monday.

The company, based in Urumqi, capital of the northwestern Xinjiang region, processes and supplies hops and barley to domestic breweries, an official at the Xinjiang Securities Management Office, which is backing the offer, told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
Shenzhen J & A Securities Co Ltd would be chief underwriter for the offer, which is likely to be launched at about 6.0 yuan per share in the first half of this year, the official said.
Xinjiang Light has not decided whether to list the shares in Shenzhen or Shanghai, he said.
Xinjiang Light currently has a total share capital of 50 million shares, consisting of 47.30 million legal person shares and 2.70 million staff shares, the official said.
If successful, the firm would funnel most of the share proceeds into its core operations, he said.
The company estimated a net profit of about 18 million yuan for 1996, compared with 10 million yuan for 1995 and eight million yuan in 1994, the official said.
